artworks.title: Christ Before Annas
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.4 × 4.3 cm (2 1/2 × 1 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a highly detailed engraving showing a group of figures clustered together, primarily depicting their upper bodies. The central figure has a halo around their head and is standing, while exchanging or receiving an object with a seated figure to the right. The seated figure is wearing a tall hat and voluminous robes, with distinct facial features, elongated beards, and detailed hair. Surrounding them are several other men in helmets and armor, some holding staffs or spears. The scene is framed with decorative motifs, including cherub-like figures at the top, archways, columns, and patterned borders along the edges. In the background, architectural details like arched windows and columns provide depth. The composition is bordered by ornate patterns, enhancing the historical and artistic theme of the engraving.

artworks.title: Christ Before Caiaphas
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.4 × 4.4 cm (2 1/2 × 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene set in an architectural setting. The scene is enclosed within an ornate architectural border that includes intricate patterns and reliefs. Two perched figures sit above the frame with crossed arms. The central vignette depicts a group of figures standing in a room adorned with archways and decorative panels, possibly in a temple or grand hall. The figures seem to be engaged in some form of discussion or procession, with some of them having halos. The composition is detailed, highlighting the interaction between the figures and their architectural surroundings.

artworks.title: The Mocking of Christ
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 4.3 cm (2 1/2 × 1 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene within an ornate frame. The image shows a group of figures gathered in a space with detailed architectural elements and columns adorned with floral patterns. At the top, there are cherubic figures hovering above. The scene depicts the figures in active poses, with detailed robes and expressions conveying a solemn atmosphere.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with Saint Longinus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 4.2 cm (2 7/16 × 1 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration of the Crucifixion of Jesus. Jesus is depicted on a cross at the center, wearing a crown of thorns, with several figures gathered around. The figures are dressed in robes with hoods or head coverings, some have halos, and one is on a horse. They display expressions of grief or reverence. The scene is surrounded by an ornate border with decorative elements, cherubic figures at the corners, and architectural elements in the background.

artworks.title: The Mocking of Christ (?)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.4 × 4.4 cm (2 1/2 × 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing within an ornate rectangular frame. In the center is a scene depicting figures in an interior setting surrounded by classical architectural elements like arches and columns. The figures are engaged in interaction with varying expressions. Above the scene is a decorative border with cherubic figures and intricate scrollwork. The background shows architectural structures and an urban landscape visible through an archway. The composition is framed by columns with floral and geometric patterns.

artworks.title: The Lamentation of Christ
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 4.2 cm (2 1/2 × 1 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene in an elaborate frame. The central image contains a group of figures engaged in a religious activity, with a horizontal figure at the bottom surrounded by other figures in robes. Above them, a burst of light radiates from behind a skull encircled by a crown of thorns. The frame is adorned with intricate motifs and carvings, including foliage designs along the sides and cherubic figures in the corners.

artworks.title: Christ Washing the Feet of the Apostles
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 4.6 cm (2 1/2 × 1 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with various figures within an architectural setting. The scene includes figures in robes, a central figure performing a humble act, architectural features such as windows with a diamond pattern, cherubic figures above the main gathering, and floral patterns decorating the architecture. The artwork is done in a classical style with detailed expressions and garments.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.5 × 4.3 cm (2 9/16 × 1 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a group scene within an architectural setting. Multiple figures are depicted in a detailed interior. The figures are closely gathered and engaged in action. The scene is enclosed within a decorated frame resembling an architectural archway. The drawing includes sculptural motifs and decorative elements. Cherubic or putti figures are depicted above the scene. The line work is detailed, capturing the textures of the architecture and figures' garments.

artworks.title: The Disrobing of Christ
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.5 × 4.3 cm (2 9/16 × 1 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of many people interacting around a seated figure. The image shows intricate line work detailing dynamic poses and expressions. The central space is filled with individuals in different actions. The background has flags and additional figures, adding depth to the scene. The drawing is framed by elaborate patterns and carvings.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait with Four Other Studies
artworks.medium: drypoint printed in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The etching depicts several partial figures. On the left is a man's face with angular features. Next to him is a woman's upper body leaning forward. Above her is another figure with long hair. At the top right is a head in profile. In the lower right is a child in a coat with raised hands. The background is plain, highlighting the detailed faces and figures with minimal detail around them.

artworks.title: Simon Vouet
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper

artworks.title: A Blacksmith (Un Forgeron)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Ritcher, and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: In the image, a man is standing in a slightly turned position, leaning over a book on a table or surface. He has short, dark hair and distinctive facial features, although details are obscured by shadows. The man is wearing a shirt with rolled-up sleeves and an open neckline, showing his muscular build. The room is dimly lit with another figure's shadow in the background, implying the presence of someone else. The background is minimal, with predominating shadows, creating contrast with the dimly lit space around the man.

artworks.title: La Terrasse de la Villa Brancas
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson
artworks.description: The image depicts two women in an illustrative style. One woman is seated on the left side holding an open parasol, while the other woman is seated on the right side holding an artist's palette and brush. The background includes foliage, trees, a building, and a distant landscape.

artworks.title: Baptism
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of figures engaging in a scene by a river. The drawing is detailed and monochromatic, showing various figures in cloaks and robes. The setting appears to be near a body of water with reflections in the foreground. In the middle ground, figures surround a central figure participating in a ceremony. The background features a pastoral scene with trees, hills, and additional figures. The style suggests a classical influence, possibly from the Renaissance or Baroque period.

artworks.title: Confirmation
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 51.7 × 66.9 cm (20 3/8 × 26 5/16 in.) trimmed to platemark
mount: 62 × 80.4 cm (24 7/16 × 31 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in an architectural setting. The figures are arranged in a classical architectural environment with arches and columns. They appear to be interacting, some seated and others standing, dressed in draped garments. In the background, there is an alcove with a statue. The use of hatching and cross-hatching techniques provide texture and shading.

artworks.title: Eucharist
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 51.8 × 65.7 cm (20 3/8 × 25 7/8 in.) trimmed to platemark
mount: 62.3 × 80.1 cm (24 1/2 × 31 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering around a long table. The composition shows a group of individuals seated and reclining on both sides of a rectangle table. The table is filled with various dishes. Above, a large lamp-like structure hangs from the ceiling, casting a shadow on the back wall. The architectural elements in the room, such as tall columns and a checkered floor, create a sense of depth and structure. The figures are depicted with detailed expressions and gestures. The perspective and line work give the image dimension, capturing the atmosphere of an intimate and historical interior setting.

artworks.title: Penance
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 51.4 × 66.3 cm (20 1/4 × 26 1/8 in.) trimmed within platemark
mount: 63 × 79.5 cm (24 13/16 × 31 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical banquet scene. The scene shows a group of figures reclining on couches around a table in an ancient architectural setting. Elaborate Corinthian columns frame the scene, which opens up to a balustraded area overlooking a scenic view with trees and cloudy skies in the background. Various dishes and vessels are on the table, and some characters are serving food or raising goblets. The detailed line work and shading give depth to the figures and architecture, conveying a sense of opulence and historical significance.

artworks.title: Extreme Unction
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 51.8 × 66.2 cm (20 3/8 × 26 1/16 in.) trimmed to platemark
mount: 62.4 × 78.6 cm (24 9/16 × 30 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with several figures interacting around a central figure on a bed. The room is depicted with strong linear perspective, showing a ceiling supported by beams and a tiled floor. The figures are engaged in various activities, such as some bringing cups and others appearing to perform a ritual or task related to the central figure on the bed who seems to be the focus of attention. The expressions and gestures of the figures indicate a sense of somberness and urgency. The detailed hatching and cross-hatching create a play of light and shadow, enhancing the depth and realism of the scene. The drawing conveys a narrative element through the arrangement and interaction of the figures within this architectural setting.

artworks.title: Ordination
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 51.9 × 66.6 cm (20 7/16 × 26 1/4 in.) trimmed within platemark
mount: 63 × 80.7 cm (24 13/16 × 31 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered in a landscape. The description includes detailed depictions of numerous individuals clothed in robes, animated in various postures and gestures as they interact with each other. The scene is set in an architectural environment with classical buildings in the background, featuring domes, columns, and bridges. The sky is filled with clouds, providing a textured backdrop. The composition captures a moment of dialogue and engagement among the individuals, where one figure appears to be addressing the group with a raised hand. The artists' technique emphasizes line drawing in a monochromatic palette with fine attention to detail in both the figures and the architectural elements.

artworks.title: Marriage
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 51.5 × 66.5 cm (20 1/4 × 26 3/16 in.) trimmed to platemark
mount: 62 × 80.2 cm (24 7/16 × 31 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an architectural setting with classical columns. The central figure is seated or positioned prominently. The setting includes columns with Corinthian capitals and a background of arches, suggesting a grand interior space. The figures are draped in flowing garments, creating movement and interaction. This drawing captures a moment of significance, with all elements drawing the viewer's focus towards the central figure or action in the center. Line work and shading add depth and detail.

artworks.title: The Forge of Vulcan
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 30.5 × 41 cm (12 × 16 1/8 in.), trimmed within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene depicting various figures working and interacting. The scene is filled with human figures engaged in industrious activities within an architectural setting resembling an ancient workshop or forge. The figures are shown in detailed anatomical poses, and the setting includes elements like stone walls, arches, and steps with textures and patterns. The combination of tools, presence of draped garments, and mythical winged figures suggest a classical or allegorical narrative. Various angelic or cherubic figures are seen assisting or in action, adding complexity to the scene.

artworks.title: The Metals Fleeing from Vulcan
artworks.dimensions: image: 17.2 × 11.4 cm (6 3/4 × 4 1/2 in.), trimmed to border
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a rugged landscape. The scene depicts several figures in various poses on a rocky terrain. In the background, there is a figure striding with what appears to be a staff, moving towards the left of the image. The figures are interacting with each other, some pointing or gesturing. The landscape is stylized with sharp, angular features, and the sky is marked with linear patterns. The drawing focuses on strong line work over shading or color.
